content.text: Create one continuous premium stylized 3D animated-film identity-reveal shot between the supplied exact first and last frames. The original young Chinese male 3D hero and the official JR mascot remain completely stationary on the same circular coral-white light platform for the entire shot. Their feet stay planted. Absolutely no running, walking, sprinting, stride pose, raised knee, chase, forward locomotion, jumping, flying, or repeated travel movement. The motion comes from the WORLD and CAMERA only: make a slow controlled half-orbit around the stationary pair while three holographic doorframes expand into distinct AI capability environments. Left becomes an AI film creator studio with cinema camera, lights and storyboards. Center becomes an AI engineering lab with robotic arms, agent graphs, data systems and code architecture. Right becomes an AI founder command space with global product reach and a small diverse team. The hero calmly turns his upper body and gaze with the camera but never steps. Preserve his same simplified sculpted animation face, graphic black hair and refined dark technical jacket. Preserve the mascot as a human-faced guide: smooth white face mask, black hair, small horns, black sunglasses, red JR tracksuit, no cow muzzle, snout, nostrils or realistic bull face. Original professional archetypes, epic scale without copyrighted superhero costumes. Deep graphite, coral and cool-blue lighting, elegant parallax, no cut, no photoreal human, no duplicate hero, no readable text, no logo, no watermark. End exactly on the supplied stationary three-world composition.
